units.source_text: 名人针对黑121，下白122，使上边白棋做眼成活。

en.t: In response to Black 121, the Master played White 122, allowing the white stones on the upper side to make eyes and live.

units.source_text: 倘使脱先，八目空地的一团白棋就可能被吃掉，劫材不够了。

en.t: If he had played elsewhere, the group of white stones with eight points of empty space might have been captured, and there would not have been enough ko threats.
